none: PAS NLM-9E4B8C: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Trier mint, but mintmark not located by this reporter in RIC volumes 7 and 8. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left, mantled with trident over shoulder. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory with shield and spear…
